description: The order in which changes are made. A chain of twenty resources each waiting for the one before, which the fork's walker carries out on a single goroutine; a diamond in which one resource waits for twelve others, some of them slow; and resources that wait for a whole module, and a module that waits for resources, through depends_on alone. Run with the default ten at once and declared orderings checked against what the provider saw, for creation, for a change that passes down every dependency, and in reverse for destruction.
